passages.query: Should I build an emergency fund or pay down credit card debt first?

passages.supporting_text: This path lowers risk and interest costs at the same time. Saving builds a cushion for emergencies and future goals. You do not want to pay down a credit card one week and then swipe it again the next because a flat tire wiped you out.
